text:
andrew: quick heads-up — ran a short host-side profile on a dedicated node for small requests (avg 64 tokens). seeing ~15-30ms host overhead before the request hits the runtime. looks concentrated in parse/tokenize + http/gRPC framing. attaching a tiny excerpt below.
maya: can you paste the excerpt? is this stable across warm/cold? :thinking_face:
andrew: paste: \n```
parse+tokenize  -> 18.4ms
http2 read     ->  3.2ms
grpc decode    ->  2.1ms
socket read    ->  1.8ms
kvcache lookup ->  4.7ms (miss-heavy)
total host     -> 30.2ms
```
warm run reduces parse by ~3ms but kvcache misses persist.
sam: hmm kvcache miss-heavy for short requests rings a bell — could be our recent shard change (PR #1428) that spreads keys more aggressively, increasing miss churn.
andrew: yeah I suspected that. it also looks like batching heuristic is triggering very small batches on ingress because preparse path sets batch_hint=1 for short flows.
kai: iirc we shipped kernel-batch-hint tweak two weeks ago. @sam can you check PR timeline? also did we change prefix caching in that PR?
sam: confirmed — PR #1428 touched kv-sharding + preparse batch hint. i can roll a quick canary reverting batch_hint. performance bot shows a tiny regression in microbench but not caught in e2e.
perf-bot: [alert] deployment canary 2024-10-11T11:23:00Z -> increased host tail latency by +12ms on p50 for small-req traces.
maya: action plan: 1) reproduce with KVCACHE_DEBUG=1 to get hit/miss ratio, 2) run host-only profile with perf+flame, 3) try reverting batch_hint locally, 4) if repro, open rollback PR for canary.
andrew: running KVCACHE_DEBUG now on staging. quick note: http/gRPC framing cost seems amplified by smallwrite syscalls — see `writev` in the stack samples.
kai: smallwrite noise could be from socket coalescing change (net patch) too. can we test with WRITEV_COALESCE=1 env to see delta?
andrew: will run both. initial thought: two independent regressions (kv sharding + net coalesce) combined create the +30ms host overhead.
sam: i'm going to bisect PR list between 1420..1435 tomorrow morning. if anyone has a good repro payload, drop it here.
maya: repro payload: single-shot chat completion, prompt length 20 tokens, content ~120 bytes. sends 1 request every 200ms to an ingress vhost.
andrew: thanks. i'll push perf traces to /tmp/host-traces/3387654321 and share link when done. also logging request headers — noticed `content-encoding: identity` vs earlier `gzip` differences.
perf-bot: deploy-log: canary rollout paused at 25% due to latency alarms.
kai: ok team — prioritize kvcache hit rates first. sam + andrew, sync after bisect. i'll own the rollback PR if needed. :thumbsup:
sam: noted. will re-run microbench with and without PR sharding and with WRITEV_COALESCE toggled.
andrew: update in ~45m with KVCACHE_DEBUG and perf flame. if we confirm, we should add a small end-to-end test asserting host preparse p95 < 40ms for short requests.
maya: agreed — adding to infra board. thanks all.
